themes.name: Brutalist（野兽派）
themes.description: 彩色野兽派 2FA 主题：排版式账本行、巨大验证码与吸顶的粗体服务页签。
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Claude
themes.description: A Claude-inspired reading room: a quiet service sidebar beside one centred column of accounts, with warm paper and terracotta accents.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Codex
themes.description: A Codex-inspired authenticator laid out as an IDE console: activity bar, explorer tree, command palette, account table and status bar.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Neon Vault · 霓虹密库
themes.description: 赛博朋克验证器：倒计时反应堆、发光服务导轨与错落的切角保险库面板。
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Ente 风格
themes.description: An Ente Auth-inspired authenticator: a menu, centred title, filter and search icons, tag chips, and flat code cards with a countdown line along the top, the next code bottom right and a round scan button.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Glassmorphism（玻璃拟态）
themes.description: 玻璃拟态 2FA 主题：浮动搜索胶囊、半透明账户名册与悬浮 Dock，支持三种配色、深色模式和实色表面。
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Journal
themes.description: A travel-journal authenticator: kraft cover, dotted pages, washi tape and a postmark stamp around every code.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Neubrutalism（新粗野主义）
themes.description: 新粗野主义 2FA 主题：撞色便当盒看板、粗黑描边与硬阴影，底部悬浮操作条。
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Pixel
themes.description: An RPG inventory authenticator: item slots, category tabs, an inspect dialog with an HP timer and pixel landscapes.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Sketch
themes.description: A pencil-and-graph-paper authenticator: sketch notes taped to a drawing board, sticky-note service labels, and precise codes.
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors

themes.name: Y2K Window · 千禧视窗
themes.description: 千禧桌面窗口：水蓝标题栏、服务文件夹资源管理器、液晶屏小部件与玻璃任务栏。
themes.author: 2FA Theme Contributors
